description: This file defines the SaleShipping controller class for the OpenCart admin report extension, handling report display, saving settings, and generating shipping-related sales reports.

classes.name: SaleShipping
classes.description: Controller class for managing the sale shipping report in OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the report page, loads language, sets breadcrumbs, and renders the shipping report form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings, checks permissions, and returns success or error in JSON.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the shipping sales report with filters and options.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates the shipping sales report data based on filters and pagination.
